intro: Every Bangkok bar on the 2025 50 Best lists, ranked — signature drinks, areas and booking.
quickAnswerHtml: Bar Us in Ari is Bangkok's top bar — Asia's No.4 and Best Bar in Thailand 2025 — followed by Dry Wave (No.5) and BKK Social Club (No.19).

blocks.html: Bangkok is one of Asia's great bar cities, and the 2025 lists prove it. 8 of these bars carry an Asia's 50 Best Bars ranking, led by Bar Us at No.4 — the highest-ranked bar in Thailand — with Dry Wave at No.5 and BKK Social Club close behind. Here is every one, ranked, with its signature drinks, neighbourhood and how to get a table.

faq.q: What is Bangkok's best bar in 2025?
faq.a: Bar Us in Ari, which ranked No.4 on Asia's 50 Best Bars 2025 and was named Best Bar in Thailand, climbing 17 places from the year before. It also sits at No.15 on the World's 50 Best Bars.

faq.q: Which Bangkok bar areas have the most 50 Best bars?
faq.a: Chinatown / Yaowarat (G.O.D, Opium, Teens of Thailand, Messenger Service), Sathorn (Dry Wave, Bar Sathorn) and the Sukhumvit strip (Bar Us, Mahaniyom, Rabbit Hole) hold most of them, all walkable in clusters.

faq.q: Do I need to book these bars?
faq.a: The top rooms fill up on weekends, so message the bar on Instagram or reserve where possible. Smaller speakeasies like Teens of Thailand and G.O.D are walk-in but can queue late.
